How It Works

The Discovery Painting Experience

Five steps, start to finish. Nothing rushed, nothing left to guesswork.

01

Request Your Complimentary Consultation

Tell us a little about your home and your vision. We’ll schedule an in-home visit at a time that works for you — no obligation, no pressure.

02

Discuss Your Home & Color Vision

We walk every room with you, talk through finishes and sheens, and offer expert color guidance suited to your home’s light, architecture, and furnishings.

03

Receive Your Detailed Proposal

A clear, itemized, written estimate — the scope and price you approve is the scope and price we deliver. No change orders sprung on you mid-project.

04

Meticulous Preparation & Painting

Furniture and floors are fully protected, surfaces are properly prepped, and premium coatings are applied with careful, disciplined craftsmanship — with daily updates so you always know where things stand.

05

Final Walkthrough & Guarantee

We review every room together before we call the job finished, and back the work with our 1-Year Workmanship Guarantee.

Common Questions

A Few Things Homeowners Ask

Do you handle exterior painting?

This program is focused exclusively on interior painting for homeowners in Ponte Vedra Beach and St. Augustine — so every interior project gets our full attention from prep to final coat.

How long does an interior project typically take?

It depends on the scope — a single room versus a whole-home repaint. We’ll give you a realistic timeline in writing as part of your proposal, before any work begins.

What’s included in the free color consultation?

An in-home walkthrough where we discuss your rooms, your lighting, your existing finishes and furnishings, and arrive at a palette you feel confident about — before you commit to an estimate.

How do you protect my floors and furniture?

Every surface in the work area is fully covered before prep begins — floors, trim, cabinetry, and furnishings — and that protection stays in place for the life of the project.

What does the 1-Year Workmanship Guarantee cover?

If a surface we painted shows a workmanship defect within twelve months of completion, we return and correct it at no charge. Full terms are provided in writing with your proposal.
